reasonForResult: Two violations found across the two submitted panels: (1) ILLEGIBLE BACK LABEL — The back label is entirely blurred and unreadable across the full extent of its text. The mandatory Government Warning (27 CFR 16.21) is present but completely illegible, violating the TTB legibility requirement that all mandatory statements must be clearly readable as printed. The importer statement and all other back-label information are similarly unreadable. (2) NON-ENGLISH COUNTRY OF ORIGIN — The front of the bottle displays 'PRODOTTO IN ITALIA' (Italian), rather than the English-language 'Product of Italy' required by CBP regulations for the US market. No English-language country of origin statement appears on any submitted panel.
